en: A modern crypto wallet built for clear, private control.
val: Sodobna kripto denarnica, zgrajena za jasen in zaseben nadzor.

key: A network fee is what you pay the blockchain — not Aperture — to process your transaction. It goes to the people running the network, never to us.
en: A network fee is what you pay the blockchain — not Aperture — to process your transaction. It goes to the people running the network, never to us.

key: A private key controls a single account on a single network.
en: A private key controls a single account on a single network.
val: Zasebni ključ nadzoruje en račun v enem omrežju.

key: A private key gives full control of this one account. Anyone who has it can move the funds.
en: A private key gives full control of this one account. Anyone who has it can move the funds.

key: A private key is the secret number that controls one account on one chain. It usually looks like a long string of letters and digits.
en: A private key is the secret number that controls one account on one chain. It usually looks like a long string of letters and digits.
val: Zasebni ključ je skrivno število, ki obvladuje en račun na eni verigi. Običajno je videti kot dolg niz črk in števk.

key: A receive address is a string that identifies one of your accounts on one specific chain. Sharing it lets someone send funds to that account.
en: A receive address is a string that identifies one of your accounts on one specific chain. Sharing it lets someone send funds to that account.
val: Naslov za prejem je niz, ki identificira enega od vaših računov na določeni verigi. Njegovo deljenje omogoča nekomu pošiljanje sredstev na ta račun.

key: A recipient can't be paid with what's left — lower an earlier amount or remove it
en: A recipient can't be paid with what's left — lower an earlier amount or remove it
val: A recipient can't be paid with what's left — lower an earlier amount or remove it

key: A recipient is an address on a blockchain — a long string that identifies one account. You can paste it, scan its QR code, or type a name that resolves to one (like an ENS name).
en: A recipient is an address on a blockchain — a long string that identifies one account. You can paste it, scan its QR code, or type a name that resolves to one (like an ENS name).
val: Prejemnik je naslov v verigi blokov – dolg niz, ki označuje en račun. Lahko ga prilepite, skenirate njegovo kodo QR ali vnesete ime, ki se razreši vanj (na primer ime ENS).

key: A recovery phrase is twelve or twenty-four plain English words. Together they are the seed your wallet was generated from.
en: A recovery phrase is twelve or twenty-four plain English words. Together they are the seed your wallet was generated from.
val: Obnovitvena fraza je sestavljena iz dvanajstih ali štiriindvajsetih preprostih angleških besed. Skupaj tvorijo seme, iz katerega je bila ustvarjena vaša denarnica.

key: A timed log of the last pull-to-refresh — every chain's balance and history API, each RPC round-trip, and every database write, with how long each took. Pull to refresh on the wallet screen, then open this and tap Copy to share it.
en: A timed log of the last pull-to-refresh — every chain's balance and history API, each RPC round-trip, and every database write, with how long each took. Pull to refresh on the wallet screen, then open this and tap Copy to share it.
val: Časovni zapis zadnjega potega za osvežitev — API stanja in zgodovine vsake verige, vsak cikel RPC in vsak zapis v zbirko podatkov ter koliko časa je vsak trajal. Povlecite za osvežitev na zaslonu denarnice, nato odprite to in tapnite Kopiraj, da ga delite.

key: A timed log of the last pull-to-refresh — every chain’s balance and history API, each RPC round-trip, and every database write, with how long each took. Pull to refresh on the wallet screen, then open this and tap Copy to share it.
en: A timed log of the last pull-to-refresh — every chain’s balance and history API, each RPC round-trip, and every database write, with how long each took. Pull to refresh on the wallet screen, then open this and tap Copy to share it.

key: A wallet built with the care a wallet should be built with.
en: A wallet built with the care a wallet should be built with.
val: Denarnica, izdelana z natančnostjo, ki si jo denarnica zasluži.

key: A wallet whose recovery phrase you never wrote down cannot be recovered. There is no backup on a server — there is no server.
en: A wallet whose recovery phrase you never wrote down cannot be recovered. There is no backup on a server — there is no server.
val: Denarnice, katere obnovitvenega gesla niste nikoli zapisali, ni mogoče obnoviti. Na strežniku ni varnostne kopije — ni strežnika.

key: A watch-only wallet shows you what an address owns and what it has done — without ever holding the keys.
en: A watch-only wallet shows you what an address owns and what it has done — without ever holding the keys.
val: Denarnica samo za ogled ti pokaže, kaj ima naslov in kaj je počel – ne da bi kdaj imela ključe.
Aktivni naslov — ima zgodovino na verigi

key: Active wallet, screen restoration, and resettable preferences.

val: XRP ohrani osnovno rezervo 1 XRP (plus 0.2 XRP na objekt) zaklenjeno, da vaš račun ostane odprt.

key: XRP keeps a 1 XRP base reserve (plus 0.2 XRP per object) locked to keep your account open. Available/Max update after a balance scan fills account state.
en: XRP keeps a 1 XRP base reserve (plus 0.2 XRP per object) locked to keep your account open. Available/Max update after a balance scan fills account state.
val: XRP ohranja 1 osnovno rezervo XRP (plus 0,2 XRP na predmet) zaklenjeno, da ostane vaš račun odprt. Na voljo/največja posodobitev po pregledu stanja napolni stanje računa.

key: XRP locks about %@ XRP as reserve (%lld owned objects × 0.2 + 1 base). That amount can’t be sent while the account stays open.
en: XRP locks about %@ XRP as reserve (%lld owned objects × 0.2 + 1 base). That amount can’t be sent while the account stays open.
val: XRP zaklene približno %@ XRP kot rezervo (%lld predmetov v lasti × 0,2 + 1 osnova). Tega zneska ni mogoče poslati, dokler je račun odprt.

key: You can back it up later in Settings.
en: You can back it up later in Settings.
val: Varnostno kopijo lahko ustvarite pozneje v Nastavitvah.

key: You can create a new wallet anytime.
en: You can create a new wallet anytime.
val: Novo denarnico lahko ustvarite kadar koli.

key: You can enable a passcode anytime in Settings.
en: You can enable a passcode anytime in Settings.
val: Geslo lahko vklopite kadar koli v Nastavitvah.

key: You can enable a PIN anytime in Settings.
en: You can enable a PIN anytime in Settings.
val: PIN lahko kadar koli omogočite v Nastavitvah.

key: You can enable lock-screen reset later from Security settings while you still know your passcode. It is off by default so someone holding your phone cannot erase Aperture without your permission.
en: You can enable lock-screen reset later from Security settings while you still know your passcode. It is off by default so someone holding your phone cannot erase Aperture without your permission.
val: Ponastavitev zaklenjenega zaslona lahko omogočite pozneje v Varnostnih nastavitvah, medtem ko še vedno poznate geslo. Privzeto je izklopljen, tako da nekdo, ki drži vaš telefon, ne more izbrisati Aperture brez vašega dovoljenja.

key: You can import this wallet again with its recovery phrase or key. Other wallets are untouched.
en: You can import this wallet again with its recovery phrase or key. Other wallets are untouched.
val: To denarnico lahko znova uvozite z njenim obnovitvenim geslom ali ključem. Druge denarnice ostanejo nedotaknjene.

key: You can leave — we'll finish it and show it on your wallet home.
en: You can leave — we'll finish it and show it on your wallet home.
val: Lahko zapustite zaslon – dokončali bomo in prikazali na začetnem zaslonu denarnice.

key: You can scan a wallet address or a payment request
en: You can scan a wallet address or a payment request
val: Lahko skenirate naslov denarnice ali zahtevo za plačilo

key: You can view balances and transaction history, but you can't send or sign anything — there's no private key.
en: You can view balances and transaction history, but you can't send or sign anything — there's no private key.
val: Vidite lahko stanja in zgodovino transakcij, vendar ne morete ničesar poslati ali podpisati — zasebnega ključa ni.

key: You don't have any wallet backups in this iCloud account yet. Create one from a wallet's recovery-phrase screen → Backup Now.
en: You don't have any wallet backups in this iCloud account yet. Create one from a wallet's recovery-phrase screen → Backup Now.
val: V tem računu iCloud še nimate varnostnih kopij denarnic. Ustvarite jo na zaslonu z obnovitveno frazo denarnice → Varnostno kopiraj zdaj.

key: You have the recovery phrase. Aperture is one of two copies.
en: You have the recovery phrase. Aperture is one of two copies.
val: Imate obnovitveno frazo. Aperture je en od dveh izvodov.

key: You haven't paid anything — we never broadcast a transaction that will fail.
en: You haven't paid anything — we never broadcast a transaction that will fail.
val: Ničesar niste plačali — nikoli ne oddamo transakcije, ki bo spodletela.

key: You will continue to onboarding with an empty wallet list. Export first if you have not already.
en: You will continue to onboarding with an empty wallet list. Export first if you have not already.
val: Nadaljevali boste z uvajanjem s praznim seznamom denarnice. Najprej izvozite, če tega še niste storili.

key: You'll follow this address's balance and activity across EVM networks.
en: You'll follow this address's balance and activity across EVM networks.
val: Spremljali boste stanje in dejavnost tega naslova v omrežjih EVM.

key: You'll follow this address's balance and activity on %@.
en: You'll follow this address's balance and activity on %@.
val: Spremljali boste stanje in dejavnost tega naslova v %@.

key: You're not signed in to iCloud. Sign in from Settings, then try again.
en: You're not signed in to iCloud. Sign in from Settings, then try again.
val: Niste prijavljeni v iCloud. Prijavite se v Nastavitvah in poskusite znova.

key: You're only charged the network base fee at inclusion
en: You're only charged the network base fee at inclusion
val: You're only charged the network base fee at inclusion

key: You've never sent to this address before. Double-check every character — crypto transactions can't be reversed.
en: You've never sent to this address before. Double-check every character — crypto transactions can't be reversed.
val: Na ta naslov še nikoli niste poslali. Dvakrat preverite vsak znak — kriptotransakcij ni mogoče razveljaviti.

key: You've never sent to this address. For large amounts, try a small test send first — once it arrives, send the rest with one tap.
en: You've never sent to this address. For large amounts, try a small test send first — once it arrives, send the rest with one tap.
val: Na ta naslov še nikoli niste poslali. Pri velikih zneskih najprej poskusite z majhnim preizkusnim pošiljanjem — ko prispe, pošljite preostanek z enim tapom.

key: Your balance card will appear here after this wallet receives crypto on-chain.
en: Your balance card will appear here after this wallet receives crypto on-chain.
val: Vaša bilančna kartica se bo pojavila tukaj, ko bo ta denarnica prejela kriptovalute v verigi.

key: Your balance changes will appear here as transactions confirm on-chain.
en: Your balance changes will appear here as transactions confirm on-chain.
val: Spremembe stanja se bodo prikazale tukaj, ko se transakcije potrdijo v verigi.

key: Your balances will appear once Aperture can reach the chains.
en: Your balances will appear once Aperture can reach the chains.
val: Vaša stanja se bodo prikazala, ko se bo Aperture lahko povezal z verigami.

key: Your encrypted recovery phrase is safe in iCloud. To restore, you will need this backup password AND your BIP-39 passphrase — Aperture never stores the passphrase.
en: Your encrypted recovery phrase is safe in iCloud. To restore, you will need this backup password AND your BIP-39 passphrase — Aperture never stores the passphrase.
val: Vaša šifrirana fraza za obnovitev je varna v iCloud. Za obnovitev boste potrebovali to rezervno geslo IN geslo BIP-39 — Aperture nikoli ne shrani gesla.

key: Your encrypted recovery phrase is safe in your iCloud. Restore it on any device by signing in and entering this password.
en: Your encrypted recovery phrase is safe in your iCloud. Restore it on any device by signing in and entering this password.
val: Vaša šifrirana obnovitvena fraza je varna v vašem iCloud. Obnovite jo na kateri koli napravi s prijavo in vnosom tega gesla.

key: Your Face ID enrollment changed. Authenticate once to trust this iPhone again.
en: Your Face ID enrollment changed. Authenticate once to trust this iPhone again.
val: Vaša registracija Face ID se je spremenila. Enkrat se overite, da boste temu iPhonu znova zaupali.

key: Your full history, contacts, and cached balances.
en: Your full history, contacts, and cached balances.
val: Vsa vaša zgodovina, stiki in predpomnjena stanja.

key: Your funds are on their way. A bridge can take a few minutes to arrive on the destination network.
en: Your funds are on their way. A bridge can take a few minutes to arrive on the destination network.
val: Vaša sredstva so na poti. Most lahko potrebuje nekaj minut, da prispe v ciljno omrežje.
Vaše imetje se bo pojavilo tukaj.
Vaš prostor za shranjevanje iCloud je poln.

key: Your iCloud storage is full. Free up space and try again.
en: Your iCloud storage is full. Free up space and try again.
val: Vaš prostor za shranjevanje iCloud je poln. Sprostite prostor in poskusite znova.

key: Your key never leaves this iPhone. Aperture does not send it anywhere.
en: Your key never leaves this iPhone. Aperture does not send it anywhere.
val: Vaš ključ tega iPhona nikoli ne zapusti. Aperture ga nikamor ne pošilja.

key: Your key wasn't kept when this wallet was imported. You still have it — to store it on this iPhone too, delete this wallet and import the key again.
en: Your key wasn't kept when this wallet was imported. You still have it — to store it on this iPhone too, delete this wallet and import the key again.
val: Vaš ključ ni bil ohranjen ob uvozu te denarnice. Še vedno ga imate — da ga shranite tudi na ta iPhone, izbrišite to denarnico in znova uvozite ključ.

key: Your keys never leave your iPhone.
en: Your keys never leave your iPhone.
val: Vaši ključi nikoli ne zapustijo vašega iPhona.

key: Your passcode unlocks Aperture. Face ID is a faster shortcut to the same lock — you can always fall back to passcode.
en: Your passcode unlocks Aperture. Face ID is a faster shortcut to the same lock — you can always fall back to passcode.
val: Vaše geslo odklene Aperture. Face ID je hitrejša bližnjica do iste ključavnice – vedno se lahko vrnete na geslo.

key: Your phrase is the key to everything
en: Your phrase is the key to everything
val: Vaša fraza je ključ do vsega

key: Your phrase wasn't kept when this wallet was imported. You still have it — to store it on this iPhone too, delete this wallet and import the phrase again.
en: Your phrase wasn't kept when this wallet was imported. You still have it — to store it on this iPhone too, delete this wallet and import the phrase again.
val: Vaše geslo ni bilo ohranjeno ob uvozu te denarnice. Še vedno ga imate — da ga shranite tudi na ta iPhone, izbrišite to denarnico in znova uvozite geslo.

key: Your private key is stored as AES-GCM ciphertext in this app’s local database. The encryption key is also kept on this iPhone. Export still requires passcode/Face ID. The key never leaves this device on its own.
en: Your private key is stored as AES-GCM ciphertext in this app’s local database. The encryption key is also kept on this iPhone. Export still requires passcode/Face ID. The key never leaves this device on its own.
val: Vaš zasebni ključ je shranjen kot šifrirano besedilo AES-GCM v lokalni bazi podatkov te aplikacije. Na tem iPhonu je shranjen tudi šifrirni ključ. Izvoz še vedno zahteva geslo/ID obraza. Ključ te naprave nikoli ne zapusti sam.

key: Your private key is stored encrypted in the local database on this iPhone (AES-GCM 256-bit). Tap “View private key” anytime — the key never leaves this device.
en: Your private key is stored encrypted in the local database on this iPhone (AES-GCM 256-bit). Tap “View private key” anytime — the key never leaves this device.
val: Vaš zasebni ključ je shranjen šifriran v lokalni zbirki podatkov na tem iPhoneu (AES-GCM 256-bit). Kadar koli tapnite »Ogled zasebnega ključa« — ključ nikoli ne zapusti te naprave.

key: Your private key stays yours. You can import this wallet again with it — there is no server, and removing it here loses nothing you've saved.
en: Your private key stays yours. You can import this wallet again with it — there is no server, and removing it here loses nothing you've saved.
val: Vaš zasebni ključ ostane vaš. To denarnico lahko z njim znova uvozite — ni strežnika in odstranitev tu ne izgubi ničesar, kar ste shranili.

en: Your recovery phrase (if you saved it) is still the source of truth. If you have an iCloud wallet backup, restore it after you continue. Aperture does not invent a successful recovery — only you can restore from phrase or backup.
val: Vaš obnovitveni stavek (če ste ga shranili) je še vedno vir resnice. Če imate varnostno kopijo denarnice iCloud, jo po nadaljevanju obnovite. Aperture ne izumi uspešne obnovitve - samo vi lahko obnovite iz fraze ali varnostne kopije.

key: Your recovery phrase is saved and your keys are secured on this device.
en: Your recovery phrase is saved and your keys are secured on this device.
val: Vaša obnovitvena fraza je shranjena, vaši ključi pa so zaščiteni na tej napravi.

key: Your recovery phrase is saved. You can find your wallet on the main screen.
en: Your recovery phrase is saved. You can find your wallet on the main screen.
val: Vaša obnovitvena fraza je shranjena. Denarnico najdete na glavnem zaslonu.

en: Your recovery phrase is stored as AES-GCM ciphertext in this app’s local database. The encryption key is also kept on this iPhone (not in iCloud Keychain). Anyone with an unlocked phone and access to the app can export it after passcode/Face ID. The phrase never leaves this device on its own.
val: Vaša fraza za obnovitev je shranjena kot šifrirano besedilo AES-GCM v lokalni bazi podatkov te aplikacije. Šifrirni ključ je shranjen tudi na tem iPhonu (ne v iCloud Keychain). key: Your recovery phrase is stored encrypted in the local database on this iPhone (AES-GCM 256-bit). Tap “View recovery phrase” anytime — the phrase never leaves this device.
en: Your recovery phrase is stored encrypted in the local database on this iPhone (AES-GCM 256-bit). Tap “View recovery phrase” anytime — the phrase never leaves this device.

en: Your recovery phrase is the only way to restore your wallet.

en: Your recovery phrase restores every account on every network. Treat it like the keys to a vault.
val: Vaša obnovitvena fraza obnovi vsak račun v vsakem omrežju. Ravnajte z njo kot s ključi do trezorja.

en: Your recovery phrase stays yours. You can import this wallet again with it — there is no server, and removing it here loses nothing you've written down.

key: Your recovery phrase was encrypted on your device with a password you chose. Only that encrypted copy lives in your private iCloud — Apple and Aperture can never read it.
en: Your recovery phrase was encrypted on your device with a password you chose. Only that encrypted copy lives in your private iCloud — Apple and Aperture can never read it.
val: Vaša obnovitvena fraza je bila šifrirana v vaši napravi z geslom, ki ste ga izbrali. V vašem zasebnem iCloudu je shranjena samo ta šifrirana kopija — Apple in Aperture je nikoli ne moreta prebrati.

key: Your recovery phrase was verified and your keys are now secured on this device.
en: Your recovery phrase was verified and your keys are now secured on this device.
val: Vaša obnovitvena fraza je preverjena in vaši ključi so zdaj zaščiteni v tej napravi.

key: Your recovery phrase will be replaced.
en: Your recovery phrase will be replaced.

key: Your wallet history, contacts, cached balances, and portfolio snapshots.
en: Your wallet history, contacts, cached balances, and portfolio snapshots.
val: Vaša zgodovina denarnice, stiki, predpomnjena stanja in posnetki portfelja.

key: Your wallet is on this iPhone only. If your iPhone is lost, broken, or wiped, your wallet — and everything in it — is gone. The recovery phrase is the only way back.
en: Your wallet is on this iPhone only. If your iPhone is lost, broken, or wiped, your wallet — and everything in it — is gone. The recovery phrase is the only way back.
val: Vaša denarnica obstaja le na tem iPhonu. Če iPhone izgubite, se pokvari ali izbriše, denarnica — in vse v njej — izgine. Obnovitvena fraza je edina pot nazaj.

key: Your wallet is ready. Back up your recovery phrase so you can restore it later if you lose this device.
en: Your wallet is ready. Back up your recovery phrase so you can restore it later if you lose this device.
val: Vaša denarnica je pripravljena. Varnostno kopirajte obnovitveni stavek, da ga boste lahko pozneje obnovili, če izgubite to napravo.

key: Your wallet is ready. Balances and activity will appear as networks refresh.
en: Your wallet is ready. Balances and activity will appear as networks refresh.
val: Vaša denarnica je pripravljena. Stanja in aktivnost bodo prikazani, ko se omrežja osvežijo.

key: Your wallet was created successfully and is ready to use.
en: Your wallet was created successfully and is ready to use.
val: Vaša denarnica je bila uspešno ustvarjena in je pripravljena za uporabo.

key: Your wallet was imported successfully and is ready to use.
en: Your wallet was imported successfully and is ready to use.
val: Vaša denarnica je bila uspešno uvožena in je pripravljena za uporabo.

key: Your written phrase is the only copy. Aperture has no copy of it — keep it safe.
en: Your written phrase is the only copy. Aperture has no copy of it — keep it safe.
val: Vaša zapisana fraza je edina kopija. Aperture nima njene kopije — hranite jo na varnem.

key: Your passcode unlocks Aperture and protects this iPhone's copy of your wallets.
en: Your passcode unlocks Aperture and protects this iPhone's copy of your wallets.
val: Vaše geslo odklene Aperture in zaščiti kopijo vaših denarnic za ta iPhone.

key: Your passcode unlocks Aperture. %@ is a faster shortcut to the same lock — you can always fall back to passcode.
en: Your passcode unlocks Aperture. %@ is a faster shortcut to the same lock — you can always fall back to passcode.
val: Vaše geslo odklene Aperture. %@ je hitrejša bližnjica do iste ključavnice — vedno se lahko vrnete na geslo.

key: Without a passcode, your wallet is only protected by your iPhone's lock screen. Turn on a passcode to require authentication every time you open Aperture — and to use %@.
en: Without a passcode, your wallet is only protected by your iPhone's lock screen. Turn on a passcode to require authentication every time you open Aperture — and to use %@.
val: Brez gesla je vaša denarnica zaščitena samo z zaklenjenim zaslonom vašega iPhona. Vklopite geslo, da zahtevate preverjanje pristnosti vsakič, ko odprete Aperture — in uporabite %@.

key: Require %@ before each of these actions. If it fails, you can fall back to your passcode.
en: Require %@ before each of these actions. If it fails, you can fall back to your passcode.
val: Pred vsakim od teh dejanj zahtevajte %@. Če ne uspe, se lahko vrnete na svoje geslo.
